unresolved_gaps: No located independent evaluation compares the publicized bet prompts with comparable fresh prompts under sufficiently similar procedures.
The available contrast does not separate prompt novelty from greater complexity or selection of successful and unsuccessful examples.
The research papers do not identify exact generation dates or establish that their tested system was unchanged from the system used for the bet.
The cited behavioral results do not identify an internal mechanism responsible for any familiarity-related gap.
